milestones.title: The world takes root
milestones.text: Fruits of the orchard, grain of the field, flowers of the meadow. From one green beginning, a world of living possibilities.
milestones.significance: Living material hub: grain, fruit, timber, fibres, seeds, flowers and later botanical studies.

milestones.title: The world begins to turn
milestones.text: Loads can roll, clay can turn, and motion can pass from one mechanism to another. A circle opens a thousand paths.
milestones.significance: Turning hub: wheelset, pottery, millstone, gears, pumps and alternate waterwheel.

milestones.title: The river lends its strength
milestones.text: The wheel, gearing and stones are joined. The river can now lend its strength to the work of feeding a village.
milestones.significance: A complete water-driven machine, not the unattached wheel or gearing; a new scale of work.

milestones.title: A new age in our hands
milestones.text: From stubborn rock comes metal we can shape. Edges, hinges, fastenings and ringing bells lie within reach.
milestones.significance: Workable-metal hub: cutting tools, nails, hinges, bells and cooking equipment.

milestones.title: The wind becomes a road
milestones.text: A craft ready to catch the wind. Across the water, distant neighbours no longer seem so far away.
milestones.significance: Complete wind-driven craft, later reused for mail. Ready to sail, not falsely already launched.

milestones.title: One voice, many pages
milestones.text: One carved message, many impressions. An invitation can now reach far beyond the hand that made it.
milestones.significance: The first successful printing, not an uninked block. Repeatable communication is the achievement.

milestones.title: Beyond the naked eye
milestones.text: A new window opens onto the very small. Even a drop of pond water may hold a world worth exploring.
milestones.significance: Complete magnifying instrument; a real pond-life observation remains to be made.

milestones.title: Care, made tangible
milestones.text: Not every great invention towers over us. Some wait beside a basin, changing the small rituals of everyday life.
milestones.significance: Everyday washing material and later shared wash station. No bar shape, germ-killing or safety promise.

milestones.title: A rhythm we can share
milestones.text: Turning wheels give the hours a face. Journeys and meetings can now keep time together.
milestones.significance: Complete housed readable timekeeper, not loose clockwork; later reused for the ferry timetable.
